contributor to MP (1881-4), mathematician, children\'s writer as ‘Lewis Carroll’

Surrey Record Office MS G103/2/10 is a letter from Dodgson to Charles Manners of Barringer, Wallis and Manners, metal box manufacturers, dated 6 September 1892, with a list of names of friends, including CMY, to whom he would like sent a Through the Looking Glass biscuit tin.
